short_description: A utilization-management nurse workbench for a health plan's prior-authorization queue. AI Functions (ai_query) pre-review every open request's clinical notes against the medical policy, quoting evidence criterion by criterion; clear cases go to an approve-only auto-approval lane, gaps get an auto-drafted provider request, possible denials go to a Medical Director. The Genie agent answers policy questions from the policy documents, decisions write back to Lakebase + Delta, and an AI/BI dashboard + Genie track CMS-0057-F turnaround (72h expedited / 7-day standard). Synthetic data only.
